description: Adds and configures one field-specific enrichment column in a sheet the user owns. Inputs are bound to stable column ids, matching exact labels and source keys automatically. When no safe binding exists, it returns the available columns and adds nothing; a retry with inputBindings sets the binding. It configures the column but does not run it, so it spends no credits.

inputBindings.description: Optional enrichment input key -> exact stable sheet column id.

name: add_enrichment_to_sheet
title: Adicionar enriquecimento à planilha
